title.english: Ave Mujica - The Die is Cast -

synonyms: バンドリ！アヴェムジカ
Ave Mujica - The Die is Cast -
description:
"Will you give me the rest of your life?"

After losing everything in a single night, Sakiko Togawa reaches out toward an even deeper abyss, one that will drag everyone around her down as well. Gathering the lives of girls burdened with their own troubles and desires, Sakiko raises the curtain on a perfect masquerade.

"Welcome to the world of Ave Mujica."

 On a stage where sorrow, death, fear, love—even the solace of forgetting—are stripped away, will their masks be torn off and shatter into oblivion, or will they….

(Source: Bushiroad)

Sakiko is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School. She is a refined person who comes from a rich family, and used to attend Tsukinomori Girls' Academy. She often plays the piano in the school's music room.

Sakiko is currently the producer, composer, and keyboardist of the band Ave Mujica. She used to be a member of CRYCHIC.

A second-year high school student. She goes by the moniker LAYER and is the vocalist and bassist for the band RAISE A SUILEN. She is Tae's childhood friend. Due to Rei's mature attitude, she has a tendency keep a certain feeling of distance with others.

She has liked singing since she was young, and now she is a professional singer who can sing any song. In addition to temporary part-time singing jobs, she used to play bass in a back up band for famous artists. Rei had also attended the same music school as Tae and Arisa.

**Height:** 156 cm

Taki Shiina is a first-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and the drummer and composer of **[MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)**.

Taki is a loner who enjoys being all alone. She works part-time at RiNG, but due to her blunt personality, short temper and the fact she has a tendency to glare at people, she isn't good at customer service. She is a bit of a perfectionist, but at the same time has an inferiority complex towards her older sister.

__Height:__ 150 cm

Raana Kaname is a third-year student at Hanasakigawa Girls' Junior High School and the lead guitarist of [MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)

Raana is an eccentric girl. She is a very talented guitarist who also has a very frank personality, as she always states what she likes and doesn't like. She is somewhat of a glutton and loves sweets, especially matcha parfaits, but also dislikes hot foods as she has a sensitive tongue.

**Height:** 162 cm

Soyo Nagasaki is a first-year student at Tsukinomori Girls' Academy and the bassist of **[MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)**

Soyo is a very kind and mature girl and she is often compared to an older sister. Due to this, she is often relied on by her peers. She has a habit of fiddling with her fingertips when she's thinking or planning something. Although not outwardly hostile, Soyo can be quite cunning at times.

__Height:__ 160 cm

Anon Chihaya is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and the rhythm guitarist of [MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/).

Anon is an honor student who is very social and also assertive at the same time. Despite this, it is shown that she has had a hard time making friends. Anon also loves following and trying out the newest trends. She approaches [Tomori](https://anilist.co/character/302095/Takamatsu-Tomori) after learning about her in hopes of creating a band together with her. Although she initially created the band in order to gain attention, to the point where she wanted to name the band after herself, she ends up becoming dedicated to her band activities and taking practicing seriously.

**Height:** 155 cm

Tomori Takamatsu is a first-year student at Haneoka Girls' High School and the vocalist and lyricist of **[MyGO!!!!!](https://anilist.co/staff/292754/MyGO)**.

Tomori is a kind but sensitive girl who has an awkward personality. She has a tendency to stutter while talking and not make eye contact. She also tends to blame herself for the conflicts that happen around her, even if they weren't caused by her.

She is infamously known as "Haneoka's Weirdo Girl" due to her peculiar personality. She likes collecting all sorts of things, such as band-aids (especially ones with animals such as pandas or penguins on them), slippery things, just-the-right-size things, and even rocks and fallen leaves that she picks up from the ground. She also likes pill bugs and has been shown often drawing them in her notebooks.
Mana became popular thanks to her cute smile and pure personality. She loves eating donuts.

Eve is half-Japanese and half-Finnish, hailing from Finland. She is a student at Hanasakigawa Girls' High School and Pastel Palettes's keyboardist. Before joining Pastel Palettes, she was a model at the same agency, and had some skill in playing the piano. She finds Japanese culture exciting, often citing bushido, the code of Japanese warriors.

She is a bright girl who tackles everything standing in her path full throttle. She is enthusiastic and chipper, eager to learn all that she can about Japan. At times her thought process can be strange, and when going on about Bushido and other samurai-related things, which she takes quite seriously, she comes off as humorous. Her actions also tend to confuse Aya and the people around her. Eve is easygoing, polite and loves hugging people. Though she has some misconceptions about Japan and sometimes misunderstands what other people say, Eve always tries her best to learn.
